_comment: Firmware metadata for AutoRoot. This file records what a package must
look like for a given phone, not where to blindly download it from.
The previous version of this file listed Google Drive links of 0.01-0.16 GB.
Those were not Samsung firmware: a real SM-A065F package is about 5.81 GB and
contains AP/BL/CP/CSC .tar.md5 members. Any entry without a verified source is
marked so and is never auto-downloaded.
samsung-fus  fetched from Samsung's Firmware Update Server via samloader-rs
manual       a file the operator supplied; still fully validated on arrival

notes: The installed build is A065FXXS4AYE2 with CSC A065FOLE4AYE2.
No trusted package digest has been recorded yet, so the internal
.tar.md5 checks are the primary integrity gate and a missing
package digest is reported as a warning, not a silent pass.
